text:
Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture under the specific devise, and Kathy's prenuptial waiver bars any pretermitted-spouse share. Kathy takes the Miami condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety Bill created by deed, since that gift is not a marital right the prenup waived, so Julie's devise adeemed and she gets nothing from it. Tommy and Julie split the residue equally, so my answer matches neither option in the team note: option 1 wrongly gives Julie the condo, and option 2 wrongly ignores the prenup's effect on the pretermitted-spouse claim.

CONFIDENCE: 60
